title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, reducing the likelihood of collisions.
mechanism: The repulsion gain parameter controls how strongly the robot reacts to nearby obstacles, influencing its avoidance behavior.
